reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "No magic number, and I won't hand you one. Heat-day sodium is individual, and it depends on how much you sweat and what you eat. In general terms, practice your fueling and fluids in training so race day holds no surprises, and don't try anything new that morning. For a specific sodium plan, a doctor or sports dietitian is the right call, especially for a hot race. If you have a marathon on the calendar, tell me the date and I'll build around it."}
